svg.title: Activity Diagram - Job Post Creation, Pausing and Admin Moderation

g.text: Activity Diagram - Job Post Creation, Pausing and Admin Moderation
Company enters title, salary, deadline and optional fields
Form shows a message, nothing is sent
title, salary and deadline filled in the form?
Deadline is a valid future date?
API returns 400 "Deadline must be a valid future date"
API generates slug (title + company + random suffix)
API creates Job with status = active
Job is listed publicly by GET /jobs and /jobs/latest
validates deadline (if sent) and status in {active, paused}
Delete the Job, its Applications and their resume files
Admin lists all jobs (GET /admin/jobs, optional status filter)
Set status = closed and moderatedBy = admin
Delete the Job, its Applications and their resume files
